name: Meiku Charts – AI Charts, Graphs & Data Tables
author: Meikuio

sections.description:
Meiku Charts (MeikuCharts) is a chart maker, graph maker and table plugin in one block. Ask ChatGPT or Claude to chart your numbers, then paste the answer into a Meiku Chart block. Preview animated charts, graphs and live data tables while you write.

Readers hover to see values, sort and search tables, or press “Chart this column”.

You can also paste code from https://meikucharts.com/chart-maker, drop an HTML, TXT or JSON file, or choose an example. Files stay in your browser.
Open a chart or table in its Meiku Charts maker from the block sidebar, then paste the updated embed back into WordPress.

Watch the walkthrough:

Pick the chart that answers your question

Choose from 26 chart types and a live table:

  • Compare with bar charts, column charts, lollipops, dumbbells, or range charts.
  • Follow change with line graphs, area charts, slope charts, bump charts, or streamgraphs.
  • Show shares with donut (pie) charts, stacked bars, waffle charts, treemaps, or sunbursts.
  • Find patterns with dot plots, ridgelines, box plots, scatter plots, or X-Y graphs.
  • Check results with waterfall charts, bullet charts, or big numbers.
  • Use grids with heatmaps, status matrices, or live data tables.
  • Follow flows with Sankey diagrams.

See every type with real data: https://meikucharts.com/examples.

Tables people actually use

Readers sort, filter, search, and turn pages. Bars highlight larger numbers. On phones, the first column stays pinned while scrolling.

Works with your AI assistant

The quickest way is chat and paste:

  1. Find “Meiku Charts” in ChatGPT’s apps or Claude’s connectors and press Connect.
  2. Ask for a chart or live table from your data, with the embed code.
  3. Paste the answer into a Meiku Chart block. Several charts become several blocks.

Your assistant can also add charts to WordPress itself:

  1. Use WordPress 6.9+ with this plugin and the official MCP Adapter active, or WordPress.com’s official connector where available.
  2. Connect your assistant to WordPress with an account that can edit the post.
  3. Ask it to add charts to a post and say where. Review before publishing.

Other AI apps can use https://meikucharts.com/mcp. Settings has setup status and prompts to copy. AI access depends on your provider. Adapter guide: https://learn.wordpress.org/lesson/the-mcp-adapter/

Read and update charts with AI

Read and update charts in blocks, shortcodes, or pasted HTML.
The MCP Adapter lists charts, reads their data, and replaces one chart with your editing permissions.
Updates check the post version. Repeating an update adds no copies.
Edit shared synced patterns in WordPress.

Charts, tables and AI in 88 seconds:

All charts in one place

Meiku Charts → All charts has live previews, search, filters, and links to edit each placement.

Fits the way WordPress works

Charts follow your theme’s light or dark mode. Charts and tables work with a keyboard and screen readers, and respect reduced motion.

The script loads on pages with charts, in the block editor and chart library.
Chart data stays in post content. The plugin stores no settings or metadata.

Free and Pro

Free charts carry a small Meiku Charts credit. Pro removes it across your whole site automatically, with no license field in WordPress. See https://meikucharts.com/pricing.

External services

Hirsch Atelier Online Seller provides Meiku Charts. The browser loads its service
on pages with charts, in the block editor, and in library results.

  • It loads https://meikucharts.com/v1/live-chart.js and /v1/ modules for interaction,
    tables, comparison, stories, export, chart families, languages, and licensing.
  • On public domains, https://lic.meikucharts.com/h/ checks a site pass for
    the hostname and up to four parent domains.
  • With a license attribute and no applicable site pass, it may request
    https://meikucharts.com/v1/license?k=&h=.
  • License requests omit cookies and the referrer. Requests expose IP addresses
    and browser headers. Scripts and modules follow the page’s referrer policy.
  • localStorage can hold a signed site pass or a no-pass marker (one hour) under
    mk:s:, and a signed key verdict under mk:v::. Valid verdicts
    are refreshed after a day and expire as specified by the service.
  • Chart data stays in the browser. No external fonts or outbound PHP requests.

Service terms: https://meikucharts.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://meikucharts.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Meiku Charts.
  2. Add a Meiku Chart block to a post or page.
  3. Paste embed code, an AI answer, or chart JSON, then press Add chart. Or press Try an example.
sections.faq:
Is MeikuCharts the same plugin?

Yes. Meiku Charts is sometimes written as one word, MeikuCharts, after its site meikucharts.com.

Do I need to install anything for ChatGPT or Claude?

For chat and paste, connect Meiku Charts in your AI app. Your WordPress site
only needs this plugin, with no MCP Adapter or Abilities API for pasting.

Can my AI assistant add charts straight into my posts?

Yes, with an authenticated WordPress connection and permission to edit the post.
The MCP Adapter offers chart-block for markup and add-chart for insertion at the
start, end, or after a paragraph. Repeating insertion adds copies. Review before publishing.

Use list-charts to find placements, get-chart to read one, and replace-chart to
update it. Reads mark large data previews as samples.

Which WordPress version do the AI abilities need?

WordPress 6.9+ includes the Abilities API. On 6.5–6.8, blocks, pasting, and
shortcodes work. Install and activate the MCP Adapter separately for AI actions.

How do I find all my charts?

Open Meiku Charts → All charts. The list includes synced patterns and uses your
existing WordPress editing permissions.

Can I use the classic editor or a page builder?

Use [meiku_chart]…[/meiku_chart] in the classic editor or a shortcode widget.
Paste HTML in text mode or use JSON if your role strips script tags.

Do I need an account?

Free makers and embeds need no account. Pro needs an active plan with your site
added. AI providers have their own account requirements.

Where does my chart data go?

Chart JSON stays in post content and renders in visitors’ browsers.
See External services for the script and license requests.

What happens without JavaScript?

Maker embed code includes a fallback table for readers without JavaScript.
The plugin preserves that table. Pasting raw JSON adds no fallback table.

Can I transform any Custom HTML block?

Only blocks containing Meiku Charts embeds and their service script, with no
other content. The plugin leaves mixed HTML blocks intact.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Charts work on cached pages. The plugin supplies WP Rocket’s script-delay
exclusion. For other optimizers, exclude https://meikucharts.com/v1/live-chart.js
from delays until a click.

How many charts can I put on a page?

Each chart’s stored JSON can be up to 512 KB. More visible charts use more memory.

Can I choose my own colors?

Set a theme in the maker or JSON, with light, dark, or auto appearance.
Table brand colors and row comparisons need Pro; check the service’s plan details.

How do I update a chart?

Select the block, press Replace, and paste the new code or JSON. Cancel restores
the current chart. Changes in the maker do not update an embed you already copied.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Chart blocks stop displaying, but their JSON stays in post content.
Shortcodes can appear as text. Reactivate the plugin to display those charts again.

Which languages does the plugin use?

The interface ships in English and can use WordPress.org language packs.
Chart titles, labels, and source text stay as written.

Does it work on multisite?

Activate per site or across your network. Pro domain coverage follows your plan.

Does the plugin run its own chart service?

The external Meiku Charts service renders interactive charts in the browser.
See External services for the requests it makes.

How can I get help?

Read https://meikucharts.com/docs or email support@meikucharts.com with your
WordPress version and a sample embed with public data.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Open a chart or table in its Meiku Charts maker from the block sidebar, or connect Claude or ChatGPT to edit it.

1.1.1

  • Charts pasted as HTML now preview and work with AI. Convert one to a block and Undo.

1.1.0

  • Ask your connected assistant to find charts in a post, read their data, and update one in place.
  • Follow two setup paths with result previews, clearer connection status, and prompts to copy.
  • Find AI setup help in the empty chart block and its sidebar.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: paste block, live preview, HTML transformation, and shortcode.
  • Preserve fallback tables and chart data for roles without unfiltered HTML.
